title: Feedback:Game updates/20260521
wikitext:
== Update 2026-05-21 ==

=== Mobile Updates ===

* Fixed issue where the hero control panel was improperly displayed full screen
* Fixed a crash when using the graphics autodetect feature
* Adjusted layout for inventory and vendors to be more usable
* Addressed other mobile UI layout problems when using different interface scales
* Korea is now part of soft launch territories

=== Account Linking is Disabled ===
* There are some internal processing issues regarding email parsing that have delayed the release of account linking.  Unfortunately this isn't obvious until you click on "Account Linking" on the web site and receive an error. 
* Account linking is not and will not be available for the free, ad supported version.

=== A note on datacenter locations ===
Since October 2021, all CD Keys generated for retail sales have been set to the American datacenter as the default.  In a similar way, any access generated on the Steam, Apple and Google platforms also default to the American datacenter.  This in no way prevents you from using the District Dropdown (PC) or Map Travel Dialog (Mobile) to choose another datacenter.  This selection is 'sticky' - you'll continue to play in that datacenter until you change it.

The American Datacenter is in Virginia.  Virginia was chosen because across all of the Americas it has the best ping.  The European Datacenter is in Frankfurt and was also chosen for its central location and is the datacenter used for the European language districts.  Finally there is a third datacenter in Seoul, Korea.  The Korean Datacenter supports all of the Asian language districts.  Feel free to choose the datacenter that gives you the best play experience.  Datacenter language and your UI language can be set independently.
